messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT opened — billing.metering.token-drift detected in prod at 02:10 UTC. severity P2. Pager routed to #incidents and oncall. <https://internal.ops/incident/1769987654|incident link>

sasha: saw the alert. shadow pipeline showing +12% token delta starting ~02:05 UTC. counts spike on batched windowing.

mike: I'm oncall — starting triage. @billing-sre can you run a quick delta by client?

billing-sre: running quick check now, pulling top clients. query:```sql
SELECT client_id, sum(delta_tokens) AS tok_delta
FROM usage_emits
WHERE emitted_at >= '2026-03-18T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY client_id
ORDER BY tok_delta DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

billing-sre: sample output (truncated):```
client_42  +1,203,412
client_7   +890,123
client_99  +12,540
```

jess: checking emitter fleet. emitter-02 (eu-west1) consumer lag jumped to 80k after a restart at 02:03 UTC. looks like batched replays landed. kafka offsets show duplicate commit attempts.

evan: are customers being flagged for overages because of this? any auto-notifications fired?

sasha: yes — our alerting flagged on the batched spike and auto-overage emails went out for ~23 customers starting 02:15 UTC.

mike: ok, mitigation plan: 1) pause auto-overage notifications, 2) start dedupe & backfill, 3) roll emitter restart patch. I'll flip notif suppression. @product-help FYI for comms gating.

jess: flipping suppress_notifs=true on /billing/alerts now. :white_check_mark: (suppression TTL 20m)

billing-sre: started reconcile job: `/scripts/reconcile_tokens.sh --window 3h --mode dry-run` then run commit. Backfill ETA ~45m for the affected window. Keeping dedupe idempotency check on.

oncall-bot: Pager updated — SRE joined the incident.

evan: rough customer-impact numbers? revenue exposure? trying to scope if we need customer-level rollback.

sasha: rough estimate: ~23 accounts saw inflated daily usage; aggregate uplift ~0.7% of daily billable tokens. most are high-throughput partners.

mike: decision — do not bill the provisional inflated counts until reconciliation completes. finance hold. @laura please confirm.

laura: acknowledged. we will hold invoice runs for affected accounts and mark items pending. need incident summary + affected client IDs to unblock billing ops.

sasha: collecting client IDs now, will upload redacted list to drive: <https://drive.internal/incident-1769987654|drive link>

billing-sre: preliminary root cause: emitter-02 consumer restart replayed batches without strict idempotency key check; kv-prefix ordering edge-case caused duplicates in token aggregation window. patch ready: enforce idempotency_key and set consumer.max_inflight=1.

jess: deploying hotfix to eu consumers (increase strict idempotency). rolling restart emitter-02 -> done. logs:```
[e] 02:20 emitter-02: consumer restart complete
[i] 02:22 emitter-02: idempotency checks enabled
```

billing-sre: reconcile run switched from dry-run -> apply. dedupe job reduced net delta. metric token-count-drift_percent now trending back to baseline (was +12%, down to +1.2% in 25m).

mike: good progress. keep suppression until post-recon verification. create incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime for RCA. Postmortem owner: sasha.

sasha: will own postmortem. timeline + RCA + customer comm draft. ETA 24h for initial write-up.

laura: we'll draft an empathetic customer note to send once we verify final counts. finance will not finalize bills for the effected accounts.

evan: closing pager for now. monitor metrics for 2 hours; if drift stable under 2% and backfills complete, we close incident.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT update: status -> mitigated. Pager closed at 02:32 UTC. Follow-ups: postmortem assigned, billing-hold in place.

mike: thanks team. quick action items: 1) sasha — postmortem & client list, 2) billing-sre — reconcile logs & run verification script, 3) jess — ensure emitter config pushed to all regions, 4) laura — coordinate customer comms.

sasha: noted. I'll post the initial postmortem doc in #incidents and link to drive.

billing-sre: verification script:```bash
python tools/verify_reconcile.py --incident 1769987654 --threshold 0.02
```

billing-sre: verification pass locally, will run across cluster.

mike: thanks. will re-open if anything flares. :thumbsup:
